framework.summary: Large frontier developers and large chatbot providers must write, follow and publish a public safety and child protection plan.
framework.quote: shall write, implement, comply with, and clearly and conspicuously publish on its website a public safety and child protection plan

transparency_report.summary: Before deploying a new or substantially modified frontier model, a large frontier developer must publish summaries of its risk assessments and results.
transparency_report.quote: conspicuously publish on its website summaries of the following

incident_reporting.summary: Frontier developers must report critical safety incidents to the Attorney General within 15 days of discovery.
incident_reporting.quote: A frontier developer shall report any critical safety incident pertaining to one of its frontier models to the Attorney General within 15 days after discovering the critical safety incident.

imminent_risk_reporting.summary: A critical incident posing imminent risk of death or serious physical injury must be disclosed to an appropriate authority within 24 hours.
imminent_risk_reporting.quote: poses an imminent risk of death or serious physical injury, the frontier developer shall disclose that incident within 24 hours

third_party_audit.summary: Large frontier developers must hire a reputable third-party auditor every calendar year to assess compliance with their plan.
third_party_audit.quote: At least once every calendar year, a large frontier developer shall retain a reputable third-party auditor to produce a report

whistleblower.summary: Developers may not block protected disclosures by employees, and large frontier developers must offer an anonymous internal reporting process.
whistleblower.quote: shall not make, adopt, enforce, or enter into a rule, regulation, policy, or contract that prevents an employee from making a disclosure protected under the Whistleblower Act

registration.summary: The bill sets no registration or licensing requirement.

shutdown.summary: The bill requires no shutdown or kill-switch capability.

compute_threshold.summary: A frontier model is one trained with more than 10^26 integer or floating-point operations, including fine-tuning.
compute_threshold.quote: trained using a quantity of computing power greater than 10^26 integer or floating-point operations

revenue_threshold.summary: A large frontier developer (with affiliates) has annual revenue of at least $500,000,000; a large chatbot provider, at least $25,000,000.
revenue_threshold.quote: collectively have an annual revenue of at least $500,000,000

harm_threshold.summary: A critical safety incident includes death or serious injury to more than 50 people, or more than $1,000,000,000 in property damage, from a catastrophic risk.
harm_threshold.quote: more than 50 people or more than $1,000,000,000 in damage to, or loss of, property

penalties.summary: Civil penalty up to $1,000,000 per violation for large frontier developers ($50,000 for chatbot providers), recovered by the Attorney General.

effective_date.summary: Takes effect in 2027; the stored text reads garbled as January 231, 2027.
